background.zh: 此詩由 Martin Nystrom 於 1984 年根據詩篇 42:1 寫成，© 1984 Maranatha! Music。經文：「神啊，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。」本檔案收錄中英歌詞，請於教會使用時依 CCLI 授權規範播放與投影。
background.en: Written by Martin Nystrom in 1984 and based on Psalm 42:1 — "As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God." © 1984 Maranatha! Music. Lyrics included for display under your church's CCLI license.

zh: 神啊 我的心切慕你
en: As the deer pants for the water
So my soul longs after you
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you
You alone are my strength, my shield
To you alone will my spirit yield
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you
